Fig. 2. Pipeline of the proposed T2S. The framework consists of a watermarked target model θT and a simulated stolen model (SSM) θS . During the rehearsal process, θS imitates the model extraction behavior to generate feedback signals, while θT is fine-tuned using the second-order derivatives of the watermark loss LWM with respect to its parameters (illustrated by the red dashed arrow). This meta-optimization enables θT to strengthen watermark robustness against potential extraction attacks.
